name: Voiceful
source:
Amberly never really has friends and it isn’t because she’s ill-mannered. It’s because people can’t understand what she’s saying to them; Amberly has a speaking disorder. 

But that won’t stop her from being an average 16-year-old girl. Amberly goes to a normal school and she absolutely loves watercolour painting!

[From [url=http://games.lockviastudios.com/2017/07/voiceful.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
安伯莉从来没有真正的朋友，这并不是因为她没有礼貌。这是因为人们无法理解她对他们说的话；安伯莉有语言障碍。

但这并不能阻止她成为一个普通的16岁女孩。安伯莉在一所师范学校上学，她非常喜欢水彩画！

[来自[url=http://games.lockviastudios.com/2017/07/voiceful.html]官网[/url]]
